nodes.label: ADR 0014: Refund Stripe Account via Snapshot, Not Resolver
nodes.rationale: Snapshot the Stripe Connect account ID on the payment row at charge time (stripe_connect_account_id_snapshot column). At refund time, use the snapshot, never the country resolver. Columns: appointments.stripe_connect_account_id_snapshot, payments.stripe_connect_account_id_snapshot, customer_profiles.stripe_connect_account_id_snapshot. Stripe handles fee reversal automatically via refund_application_fee:true so no fee% calc needed. Same pattern for saved-card charges.
alternatives_rejected: Re-resolve at refund time via country resolver (race after tenant restructuring)
Store only PaymentIntent id, look up via Stripe API (extra API call + network failure point)
